findings.title: Soccer seed pin recorded at re-seal cef8412c does not match the actual seed file (fabricated digest tail after the correct 12-char abbreviation)
findings.evidence: pins.json packages.soccer.files['PROVIDER_NAME_CROSSWALK_SEED.csv'].sha256 = f5b85fb9ea2b9219b80c150564e20d4c0d0aa1e97b07a7d59de25c46d1ce5f77. Actual file (soccer prep worktree @ a8057a95, git-clean, last touched by cc7a3546) = f5b85fb9ea2baa083c4c8cdc34a2462d6f5fa4bc0c4fbe2f17c183b734d03441 (direct shasum + verify-pins measurement, both agree). The true digest is recorded in the prep lane's own control artifact research/control/SOCCER-INTL-WINPROB-PROSPECTIVE-PREP-V1/CONTROLLER_CROSSWALK_20261009.md:35. The two hashes agree only on the first 12 hex chars (the abbreviated form used in commit messages/notes); no normalization variant (no-trailing-newline, CRLF, whitespace-stripped) produces the pinned value, so the pin tail was not derived from any measurement of the file. Non-blocking at runtime: the seed entry is required:false (verify_pins reports DRIFT in the per-file status but does not raise BLOCKED_PIN_DRIFT and top-level drift[] stays empty, exit 0), and production never consumes the seed pin - adapters load the extension (required:true, sha fail-closed) and enforce ext_bytes.startswith(seed FILE bytes) at load (adapters.py L787-793). But the seal act's own evidence record is false as written, violating the cycle's identity law, and any future verify_pins(include_optional=['soccer/PROVIDER_NAME_CROSSWALK_SEED.csv']) or re-seal trust chain will trip on it.
findings.suggested_repair: One-line re-pin: set the seed entry sha256 to f5b85fb9ea2baa083c4c8cdc34a2462d6f5fa4bc0c4fbe2f17c183b734d03441 with an erratum note citing this audit + CONTROLLER_CROSSWALK_20261009.md; separately consider extending build_soccer_crosswalk_extension.py to also print the measured seed sha256 (it currently prints only the extension sha) so a future seal cannot record an unmeasured digest. Optionally make verify_pins include this optional file by default in probe mode so drift is visible without raising.

findings.title: 2-way quote legs evidence records fee_total=None (field-name mismatch with walk_ask's fee_cents)

The evidence field is always None; live_dashboard.js reads fee_total_usdc for display. Fee economics are NOT affected: the taker fee is included in walk spend and therefore in vwap_ask, and odds=1/vwap_ask.

findings.title: PAPERTRADE_AI_OPINION_JSON in real mode is silently inert instead of raising BLOCKED_TEST_HOOK_IN_REAL_MODE
findings.evidence: execute.load_ai_opinion L1733-1742: the env var is only read when args.sandbox is true; in real mode with the env set, seam stays None and the loader falls through to the opinions dir - the hook can never take effect (fail-safe), but unlike the pm_probe seam (which raises BLOCKED_TEST_HOOK_IN_REAL_MODE on env in real mode, _pm_probe_seam L1193-1197) no block code is raised, so an operator setting the env in a real run gets silence instead of a refusal. args.ai_opinion DOES raise in real mode.
findings.suggested_repair: For symmetry with the pm_probe seam, raise BLOCKED_TEST_HOOK_IN_REAL_MODE when the env var is set and sandbox is false, before the sandbox-guarded read.

findings.title: 3-YES joiner diagnostic specificity reduced at ef45e249; KEEP branch regrades a subset, full set enforced upstream
findings.evidence: (a) ef45e249 refactored discover_and_join_3yes to scan all variant responses via _join_3yes_in_event; a title-matching event with incomplete legs is now skipped silently and the final failure reason is the generic 'no 3-YES event joined for X vs Y' (previously the per-event '3-YES join incomplete: legs=...'). Fail-closed NOT_RUN_PM_QUOTE is preserved (execute.py L1277-1281); only the journal detail is coarser. (b) evaluate_ai_gate KEEP branch regrades G_EV_KEEP+G_PIT_KEEP only; the FULL frozen set still gates the actual placement because risk.evaluate_match ran it before the boundary and risk.in_lock_recheck re-runs cap/availability in-lock at append - the AI gate is an additional demotion layer, not the sole gate. Documented here so the round-17 law text ('KEEP ... regraded against the FULL frozen gate set') is read as enforced-in-aggregate.
findings.suggested_repair: (a) Have _join_3yes_in_event return the best partial-join reason and surface it in the NOT_RUN_PM_QUOTE detail. (b) None required; optionally add a comment in evaluate_ai_gate pointing at evaluate_match/in_lock_recheck as the full-set enforcement.
